candidates.title: The Aqueduct's Hidden Tremor
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the aqueduct walkway shook only when the town fountain stopped before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they reinforced the railing but the tremor continued; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a pressure surge struck a loose valve whenever the fountain shut off; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they installed a controlled valve closure and verified the walkway remained stable, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Seeds That Would Not Sleep
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered sealed seed packets began sprouting inside the community seed vault before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they replaced the packets but new sprouts appeared again; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a faulty humidity sensor was reporting dry air while the room remained damp; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they repaired the sensor and dried the vault before preserving fresh seeds, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Shadow That Arrived Before the Balloon
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a festival balloon cast a shadow on the field before spectators could see it before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they searched the clouds for a second balloon but found nothing; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the balloon was concealed behind a hill while the low sun projected its shadow ahead; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they moved the viewing point and mapped the balloon's safe approach, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
